input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for book application, edge application. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to use book application capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to use edge application capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Candidate, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
